test_name: Separator-bar styling settings reach the render (set 006)
description: cnb:keysig-bar-color, cnb:keysig-bar-thickness and cnb:keysig-bar-extent-semis replace the values that used to be hard-coded in cnb/keysig.ly (cnb:gold, thickness 4, ±1 octave). This score sets the bar to pure blue, thickness 8, and ±2 octaves (extent 24 semitones). The key-signature element must render in blue, and its bounding box must be taller than the default ±1-octave bar (whose height is 12.5 on this staff), confirming the extent setting drives the bar geometry.

assertions._comment: === SECTION 1: THE BAR RENDERS IN THE OVERRIDDEN COLOR ===

assertions.description: Key signature renders in the overridden blue (not the default gold)

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: THE EXTENT SETTING DRIVES THE BAR HEIGHT ===

assertions.description: Extent 24 semitones (±2 octaves) makes the bar taller than the default 12.5
Noteheads render normally alongside the styled key signature
